name: IM-2 Athena (CLPS 2025)
note: Real NASA CLPS landing by Intuitive Machines, 6 March 2025 (location approximate, as reported).
story: Athena's site and date were excellent: our model shows 100% sunlight and Earth in view for its planned 10-day mission, on a gentle slope. But it touched down about 250 m off target inside a small crater, smaller than these 80 m maps can show, and tipped onto its side. Its power ran out within about a day. The lesson: pick the right place and date (this tool), then map hazards at even finer scale.
